title: 第2章 我们分手吧
slug: 前任渣我五年闪婚他哥被宠成宝
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

时夏禾回到出租屋时，已经是半夜。

十几平的房间里，到处都是他的痕迹。

玄关处穿旧的男士拖鞋，洗手台上并排放着的牙杯，床头柜上她省吃俭用给他买的剃须刀，衣架上那件洗得发白的廉价外套……

每一样，都在提醒她，这里曾经住着一个叫阿深的人。

她抬眼，看见墙上那张褪色的大头贴。

照片里的男人穿着廉价白T，低头亲着她的脸，眉眼温柔。

那时他抱着她说：“阿禾，等我赚到钱，就让你过好日子。”

时夏禾盯着那张照片，忽然觉得可笑。

原来他说的好日子，是转身回去和别人订婚。

那她这掏心掏肺的五年算什么？

算他失忆落难时的一场消遣？

手机忽然震了一下。

晏瑾深发来消息：【今晚有个很重要的客户要陪，可能回不去了。你先睡，明天我再跟你解释。】

陪客户？还是陪宋小姐？

又或者，是陪那位即将和他订婚的夏小姐？

她看了很久，久到屏幕暗下去。

最后只打了五个字过去：【我们分手吧。】

这一夜，她没有收到任何回复。

第二天一早，时夏禾照常出门上班。

上午去中药房兼职抓药，老板冷着脸把她赶了出来。

中午去街角麻辣烫摊位帮厨，摊主让她以后别来了。

下午去写字楼干保洁，主管直接堵在门外，连门都没让她进。

一天之内，三份工作全丢了。

时夏禾站在阳光底下，手脚冰凉。

她第一反应，是爷爷的死对头又在搞她。

那老东西这些年一直卡着她的行医证，让她开不了诊所，进不了医院，连像样的医药公司都不敢要她。

现在，连这种苦力活也不肯放过了吗？

她拦住刘主管：“是不是有人在背后搞我？”

刘主管四下看了看，压低声音：“小禾啊，听说你昨晚得罪了晏少，现在圈子里都传开了，谁敢用你，就是跟晏家过不去。我们这种小公司，哪敢冒这个险？”

时夏禾从写字楼出来，失魂落魄地走在街头。

晏瑾深骗她、绿她，现在还要断她的活路。

手机偏在这时响起。

电话那头是老家药房护士焦急的声音。

“小禾，你妈体内余毒又反复了，疼了一整晚。医生说得尽快用紫芝护心液，不然晚上还会加重。”

时夏禾喉咙发紧：“好，我马上去买药。”

当年，爷爷和人争市中医协会会长的位置，对方明着争不过，就在水井里投了毒。

爷爷因此含恨离世，养父撑了三年也走了。

如今只剩养母，中毒最轻却也伤了根本，全靠时夏禾一副副苦药吊着命。

可隔段时间毒性反复，就必须靠昂贵药剂缓解痛苦。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

When Shi Xiahe returned to the rental house, it was already midnight.

There are traces of him everywhere in the room of more than ten square meters.

The worn-out men's slippers in the hallway, the tooth cups placed side by side on the sink, the razor she bought for him frugally on the bedside table, the cheap coat on the hanger that was washed white...

Everything reminded her that a man named Ah Shen once lived here.

She raised her eyes and saw the faded photo on the wall.

The man in the photo was wearing a cheap white T-shirt, lowering his head and kissing her face, his eyebrows gentle.

At that time, he hugged her and said, "Ah He, when I make money, I will let you live a good life."

Shi Xiahe stared at the photo and suddenly felt ridiculous.

It turns out that the good life he was talking about was when he turned around and went back to get engaged to someone else.

So what are the five years she spent devoting her heart and soul to her?

Consider it a pastime when he lost his memory and was in trouble?

The phone suddenly vibrated.

Yan Jinshen sent a message: [I have a very important client to accompany tonight, and I may not be able to go back.You go to sleep first and I will explain to you tomorrow.】

Accompany clients?Or stay with Miss Song?

Or, to accompany Miss Xia, who is about to get engaged to him?

She looked at it for a long time, until the screen went dark.

In the end, I only typed five words: [Let’s break up.】

That night, she received no reply.

Early the next morning, Shi Xiahe went out to work as usual.

In the morning, she went to a traditional Chinese medicine pharmacy part-time to get medicine. The boss kicked her out with a cold face.

At noon, she went to the street corner Malatang stall to help cook, but the stall owner told her not to come again.

When she went to the office building to do cleaning work in the afternoon, her supervisor blocked the door and didn't even let her in.

In one day, all three jobs were lost.

Shi Xiahe stood in the sun, his hands and feet were cold.

Her first reaction was that her grandfather's nemesis was messing with her again.

That old guy has been holding up her medical license all these years, preventing her from opening a clinic or entering a hospital. Not even decent pharmaceutical companies dared to hire her.

Now, are you even unwilling to let go of this kind of hard work?

She stopped Manager Liu and asked, "Is someone doing something behind my back?"

Manager Liu looked around and lowered his voice: "Xiaohe, I heard that you offended Mr. Yan last night. Now it has spread in the circle. Anyone who dares to use you will be in trouble with the Yan family. How can a small company like ours dare to take such a risk?"

Shi Xiahe came out of the office building and walked down the street in despair.

Yan Jin had lied to her, had sex with her, and now wanted to cut off her livelihood.

The cell phone rang at this moment.

On the other end of the phone was the anxious voice of a nurse from my hometown pharmacy.

"Xiaohe, the residual poison in your mother's body has returned again, and she has been in pain all night. The doctor said that you need to use Zizhi Heart Protecting Liquid as soon as possible, otherwise it will get worse at night."

Shi Xiahe's throat tightened: "Okay, I'll buy medicine right away."

Back then, my grandfather was competing for the position of president of the city's Traditional Chinese Medicine Association. The other party knew he couldn't compete, so he poisoned the well.

Because of this, my grandfather passed away with regret, and his adoptive father also left after three years.

Now only the adoptive mother was left. The poisoning was the most minor but it also damaged her roots. She relied on Shi Xiahe's bitter medicine to hang on to her life.

But the toxicity recurs over time, and expensive drugs must be used to relieve the pain.
